what: Bo asks for the open seat (A, B). B also holds a _dai_confirm row seating Bo in it, under Ada's author id, that no header covers: written straight into the roster table, unsigned. The merge into A refuses it BATCH_UNSIGNED in the name of the id it carries, under no id, and takes nothing: on A nobody holds the open seat. B keeps the row it holds, which is where union merge stops, and it seats nobody there either: a row no header covers, under an id not B's own, is not a row of the merge (merge-row-unsigned, uncovered-row; review 10, A06; D194).
